qolFindings.title: With the telephone off, a birth date in the Telefono column is still dropped unseen, and a '-' or 'N/D' placeholder there makes the whole line unread
qolFindings.scenario: Probe round5/paste.probe. 'Veldor;Marta;;16;12/03/2010' is read as a student with age 16 and no birth date, and nothing is reported: LOOKS_LIKE_PHONE accepts digits with '/', so the date counts as a telephone and is ignored. The V5F-4 disposition says a value that is not a telephone is shown. 'Veldor;Marta;12/03/2010;;-' and '…;;N/D' become unread lines ('nella colonna Telefono c’è «-»…'). An assistant that fills every empty Telefono field with '-' would turn a 40-row answer into 40 unread lines. No wrong student is saved in either case.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: When the telephone column is ignored, treat '-', '—' and 'N/D' as empty. Exclude date-shaped values (DD/MM/YYYY) from LOOKS_LIKE_PHONE so they are shown. Add both cases to the corpus.

previousFindingsVerified.note: confirmedCount holds a number. pasteCountConfirmed requires no unread line and confirmedCount === candidates.length. 'Sono tutti' is disabled while a line is pending, with the text 'Prima decidi le righe non lette'. The question is asked again after a removal. Rows can only be added by Rileggi riga, which needs a pending line, so the count cannot be brought back to a stale number. Tieni entrambi does not change the count. A re-paste resets it to null.
